statement: On the recorded pumpswap tape read only from trader.db (2839 instruments, 324480 readings, every instrument with at least 20 readings), 7 typed sensors (real SOL, age, trading and buying intervals in the last 6 readings, reserve slope, market births in 600 s, migrated origin) fed the venue.trader gate; 120 generations of 64 genomes (7548 evaluations) over the gate and a trailing exit were selected on TRAIN only (2126 instruments, the development set) by the smaller fold t statistic of the per instrument gap to an age binned baseline, and the one elite (gates realSolMin 12.19, realSolMax 5208, ageMin 30.22, ageMax 141.8, tradesMin 3, slopeMin 0.09485, birthsMin 2, maxEntries 3; exit trail 0.02014, trailArm off, stopLoss 0.3768, maxHold 49, takeProfit 1.179) was graded once on the 713 HELD OUT instruments at the payable price after the borrowed 0.0454 fee charged on both legs. It made 498 trips on 390 instruments at -9.54% per trip (-0.94975 SOL), win rate 45.98%, its top 5 percent of trips carrying 41.87% of its winnings; its age matched control (the same 498 trips, 16 random entries each on other holdout instruments within 30 s of the same age, the same exit, size and fee; 0 trips had no instrument alive at their age and were excluded from both arms) made -32.62% per trip, win rate 34.27%. The per instrument gap is 0.16123 of size with a 95 percent interval [0.12881, 0.19364] and nFor95 29, so the elite BEATS its control and the bar is MET, though its trips do not clear the fee. Against random times on the SAME instruments (the board 8 control, same exit) the per instrument gap is 0.04189 [0.01823, 0.06555]. Per trip the elite gains 0.23083 [0.18978, 0.27189] over its age control; the same exit with no gate (4259 trips) gains 0.07289 [0.05505, 0.09073] per trip over its own (per instrument 0.43539 [0.31255, 0.55823]; a per instrument sum grows with trip count, a per trip gap does not): the exit with no gate already beats random entries at the same ages, so part of the gap is the exit and the entry timing it allows, and the gate adds per trip gap beyond it (the two per trip intervals do not overlap). On the holdout census the sensors whose beats-the-age-bin AUC interval excludes 0.5 are realSol 0.5424, ageS 0.3543, trades 0.5463, buyers 0.5580, slope 0.5723, migrated 0.4657. 0 of 8466 trips filled better than the reported ratio, every trip paid the both legs fee of its own proceeds, the organism book was identical to the kernel on 12 holdout instruments, and a second grade was identical. Nothing placed an order; wall times are of a shared machine and no latency is claimed.
claim: the sensor elite BEATS its age matched control on the holdout: the 95 percent interval of the per instrument gap excludes zero on the favourable side, but its trips do NOT clear the fee on both legs (-9.54% per trip): an edge over random entries at the same ages, not a profit
sharedMachine: measured on a shared machine (other sessions and one Ollama queue); wall times are not latencies and no latency is claimed
units: every net, netPerTrip, gap and tail number is in units of the entry size (1.0 = one entry of size SOL) at the payable price after the fee on both legs; netSol = net x size; meanHeld in readings; ages in seconds

fee.assertion: FEE_BAR is the measured 4.54% round trip
fee.legs: fee/2 of the buy notional + fee/2 of the sell proceeds; a flat trip pays exactly the round trip fee

fills.note: payable price from the recorded reserves; a buy fills only when size / SOL reserve <= maxImpact; sells always fill

list.name: realSol
list.doc: the quote (SOL) reserve at the decision reading: the real SOL in the pool

list.name: ageS
list.doc: seconds since the pool was born (pool_state.age_s; 0 at the CreatePool reading)

list.name: trades
list.doc: readings among the last SENSOR_WINDOW where the reserves moved along the curve since the reading before: at least one swap happened in between (a count of trading intervals; the tape cannot count swaps inside one interval)

list.name: buyers
list.doc: readings among the last SENSOR_WINDOW where the SOL reserve ROSE since the reading before: net buying in that interval (buy-side intervals, NOT distinct wallets, which the tape does not carry)

list.name: slope
list.doc: the SOL reserve now over the SOL reserve SENSOR_WINDOW readings ago (or at birth when younger), minus one

list.name: births
list.doc: pools of this venue born in the BIRTH_WINDOW_S seconds up to this reading, market wide (the pool table, by t_local: when the desk saw each birth)

list.name: migrated
list.doc: 1 when the pool was born by a cpi out of the pump.fun program (a graduated curve), 0 when a wallet or anything else created it

split.development: train: the search, its two folds, its age baseline and every TRAIN line
split.heldOut: holdout: read once after the search by gradeSensorElite and sensorAucs

search.yearsArithmetic: 7548 evaluations x 243045 readings = 1834503660 readings; x 20.088 s per reading = 36851509522 market-seconds; / 31557600 s per year = 1.1678e+3 market-years replayed

manifest.fitness: min over two train folds (hash32 of "venue.fold/1:" + id, bit 0) of the t statistic over instruments of the per instrument sum of (trip return after the fee minus the mean return of every fillable entry of the same fold in the same age bin under the same exit); a genome under minTrips = 213 trips scores -1000 + trips / minTrips
grid: migrated gate (wallet vs any or migrated)

elite.exit: trail 0.02014, trailArm off, stopLoss 0.3768, maxHold 49, takeProfit 1.179

aucs.note: every fillable entry once under the elite exit with no gate; win = return over zero after the fee; beatsAge = return over the mean of its age bin in the same census; intervals from resampling instruments

unmodelled: the tape after our own order is the recorded tape: our fill moves nothing the next reading reports
every instrument is its own book: no cap on positions open at once across instruments
the fee is borrowed from pump.fun; the round trip cost of pumpswap has never been measured
the holdout is split by instrument, not by time: holdout instruments share the train instruments calendar
trades and buyers count reading intervals with a move (or a rise) of the SOL reserve, not swaps or wallets, which the tape does not carry
